rationale: All three lenses ran successfully over the two-repo diff. Acceptance audited all 6 criteria against the real code — every one passes (env->/v1/config bridge reused, no SettingDeclaration path, per-provider git->GitLab gating, presence=enabled, tests both repos, id contract matches). Blind lens: no blocking findings (verified the features:gitlabOauth/jiraOauth/confluenceOauth ids match byte-for-byte across repos, the flag read is null-safe, useFeatureFlag is called unconditionally, and the hide-gate is not inverted). Edge-case lens: 1 finding, minor and dismissed — the base type 'git' folds GitHub+GitLab so a GitHub git integration could be offered GitLab OAuth; explicitly pre-existing, not introduced by this change, and matching the documented 'only GitLab has OAuth on Git' assumption. Standards: commit subjects conform to single-ticket EPMCDME-14587: format; ruff check/format and tsc clean; no secret/token handling. Dismissed findings: 1 (minor).
